scripts.dev: npm run build:sim && npm run dev --workspace @doofy-duck/web -- --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.check:browser: npm run test:browser && npm run test:dev
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run check:browser
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && playwright test -c apps/web/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:dev: npm run build:sim && playwright test -c apps/web/playwright.dev.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:sim && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p services/core/typescript/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build:sim && npm run build:web
scripts.lint: eslint packages/game-sim/src packages/game-sim/test apps/web/src apps/web/test services/core/typescript/src services/core/typescript/test
scripts.check:backend: npm run check:backend:python && npm run check:backend:core
scripts.check:backend:python: cd services/platform && uv sync --locked --group dev && uv run ruff format --check app migrations tests ../../deploy/scripts/backend-smoke.py && uv run ruff check app migrations tests ../../deploy/scripts/backend-smoke.py && uv run mypy app && uv run python -m pytest -q
scripts.check:backend:python:integration: test -n "$PLATFORM_TEST_DATABASE_URL" || { echo 'missing PLATFORM_TEST_DATABASE_URL'; exit 2; }; test -n "$ECONOMY_TEST_DATABASE_URL" || { echo 'missing ECONOMY_TEST_DATABASE_URL'; exit 2; }; cd services/platform && uv sync --locked --group dev && uv run ruff format --check app migrations tests ../../deploy/scripts/backend-smoke.py && uv run ruff check app migrations tests ../../deploy/scripts/backend-smoke.py && uv run mypy app && uv run python -m pytest -q
scripts.check:backend:core: npm run build:sim && tsc -p services/core/typescript/tsconfig.json && vitest run services/core/typescript/test
scripts.check:backend:core:integration: test -n "$CORE_TEST_DATABASE_URL" || { echo 'missing CORE_TEST_DATABASE_URL'; exit 2; }; vitest run services/core/typescript/test
scripts.check:backend:integration: test -n "$PLATFORM_TEST_DATABASE_URL" || { echo 'missing PLATFORM_TEST_DATABASE_URL'; exit 2; }; test -n "$ECONOMY_TEST_DATABASE_URL" || { echo 'missing ECONOMY_TEST_DATABASE_URL'; exit 2; }; test -n "$CORE_TEST_DATABASE_URL" || { echo 'missing CORE_TEST_DATABASE_URL'; exit 2; }; npm run check:backend:python:integration && npm run check:backend:core:integration
